articleTitle: Realization of Si Based Vertical PIN Photodiode Structure in COMSOL Multiphysics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: This paper reports a PIN-photodetector modelled and characterized in COMSOL Multiphysics. A highly efficient vertical PIN structure on p-Si substrate has been simulated and the performance of the device measured under broad light ranging from 300-1100 nm. The resultant PIN-Si device shows maximum responsivity of 0.73 A/W for 1010 nm illumination wavelength for 1 V applied bias. The obtained broad optical response i.e., 300-1100 nm along with compact geometry make this device structure an efficient light detector in optical as well as industrial applications.

articleTitle: Impact of Side-wall Spacer on The Performance of Double Gate Steep Switching Tunnel FET
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: The tunnel field effect transistor is a promising option for low power integrated circuit applications because it allows the possibility of steep switching between on and off states. The influence of various parameters on the performance of pocket doped double gate silicon n-type tunnel field effect transistor has been investigated with help of extensive device simulation for different space thickness and spacer dielectric values. The performance of the device is degraded significantly with increasing spacer thickness. The device is also subjected to low-k (k = 1, 2.8) as well as high-k (k = 9, 25) spacer dielectric but on current level not much altered.

articleTitle: Polyaniline Wrapped Graphene/TPU Composites – A Potential Candidate for Electromagnetic Interference Shielding
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: Graphene-based polymer nanocomposites have been considered to have a significant promise to create commercially viable electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding materials. In the present study, we carry out a systematic analysis of the EMI shielding ability of Polyaniline wrapped graphene nano sheets in thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) matrix. The composites were prepared by solution casting method using graphene coated with polyaniline. The coating was done by in-situ and ex-situ chemical oxidation polymerization of aniline in presence of graphene nano sheets (GN). The composites thus prepared were designated as GN/PANI/TPU(I) and GN/PANI/TPU(E), respectively. In-situ polymerisation was carried out to achieve excellent dispersion and adhesion of the conductive filler in the TPU matrix. The improved dispersion of conductive filler in the case of PANI/GN/TPU(I) composites was confirmed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images. The electrical and electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding properties of the prepared composites were studied. The percolation threshold of GN/PANI/TPU(I) composites was found low (0.46 wt %). These composites displayed a conductivity of 31.56 S/m and EMI shielding efficiency of 40.6 dB in X band region at 6% filler concentration. For GN/PANI/TPU (E) composites, the corresponding values were 5.18 S/m and 23.4 dB respectively. This improved efficiency of EMI shielding can be caused by a well-organized conductive network of fillers in TPU matrix.

articleTitle: Review on Stress Detection and Management Techniques using Nano EEG Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to review recent researches on several stress prediction and detection techniques and also to provide better stream line on various stress management techniques. Worldwide, people experience mental stress concerns with different reasons including family issues, financial issues, social issues and environmental issues. The adjustable stress can develop a person; however, the strong response or continuous stress becomes critical. Hence, prediction, detection and management of physical and mental stress become important research area. It is necessary to predict the stress level earlier to avoid the major chronic health disorders to an individual’s well-being. Nowadays, depending on physiological measures such as Skin Conductance (SC), Heart Rate Variability (HRV), Electroencephalogram (EEG), Electromyogram (EMG), Electrocardiogram (ECG), Sleep Pattern, Galvanic Skin Response (GSR) and Skin Temperature more research is going to determine various stress detection techniques. The behaviour of physical and mental stress is studied with the help of emerging technology such as Internet of Things (IoT).The detected stress measurements are managed efficiently by cloud based work and smart phone applications to track and compute large data with long duration. In this review paper, the Nano based EEG sensors is developed for measuring the stress which avoids the number of sensors EEG electrodes when compared with the traditional it is reduced and the regular EEG sensor mounting problem is solved with proposed Nano EEG sensor.

articleTitle: Data-driven modeling for tribological performance of nano-lubricants using artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: There is an upsurge in demand for newer lubricants which effectively can reduce friction, protect contact surfaces from wear, corrosion, oxidation, and provide thermal stability. The present study addresses the need of expediting the research with the use of Artificial Intelligence and data-driven modeling. This article aimed at prediction of tribological performance of lubricant with addition of nanoparticles (NP) additives using data available in the literature. A data-driven modeling is used to find the relationships between input and output variables of a system without knowing the physical behavior of the system. In this study key attributes (input) are identified and tribological performance parameters (output) are specified. The relationship between the inputs and outputs is established by correlation analysis and artificial neural network (ANN) model.

articleTitle: Extraction of Space Debris Approach: Diminish the Threats from Outer Space
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: Over the past few decades, Space junk has become one of the major challenges for the peaceful operation of satellites and professional space missions in LEO (low Earth orbit). Debris is a major threat to operational spacecraft; Just a tiny debris also can cause huge damage to various parts of a spacecraft. Moreover, each collision will escalate the debris number. To address the threat of outer space, we have analyzed on how to create them reliable and safe space environment to prevent loss of spacecraft to debris collision. Several space institutions in order to demonstrate key ADR (Active Debris Removal) techniques in a cost-effective ambitious way as well as various contemporary concepts (collective, laser-based, ion-beam shepherd-based, tether-based, sail-based, satellite-based, unconventional, and dynamical systems-based) of debris removal, which is developing at a rapid pace. The article will provide an updated concept for removing the space garbage by capturing the junk objects and using multiple drag sail concepts. The remove debris mission brings a huge opportunity in the area of safe satellite communication and the ultimate goal of a cleaner Earth orbital environment.

articleTitle: A Study on Optical Interconnects to Improve On-Chip Wireless Communication using Plasmonic Nanoantennas and Seeking Dielectric Nanoantenna as an alternative
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: Today’s wireless communication technology mainly makes use of radio waves and microwaves. These electromagnetic waves are transmitted and received using antennas. Recently emerged free space optical communication technology uses light waves traveling in free space to transmit data signals. For this our bigger antennas are replaced by minute optical nanoantennas. A main problem faced in optical communication technology is insufficient electromagnetic spectrum initialization. Nanoantennas are capable of solving this problem to a certain extent. The concept of optical nanoantennas is still in the very first phase of evolution. Developments in nanotechnology have improved nanoantenna fabrication techniques. So, a theoretical study of nanoantennas is highly desirable. This review paper provides an insight into various aspects of nanoantennas. A comparison between different types of nanoantennas is also done.

Author Keywords: near field inter/intra chip optical communication

articleTitle: Design of PERC Cell using SiO2, Si3N4, and Al2O3 with the Novel technique for enhanced absorption of silicon selective emitter for solar cell processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: In this research work, the high efficiency "Passivated Emitter Rear Cell (PERC)" solar cell design was performed which acquires severe impact on bulk lifetime, the incident angle of the solar radiation, and temperature dependence on electrical properties of measured PERC device. In this research work, the major intention is to fabricate the PERC solar cell by doping various chemicals around the surface such as SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. The simulation is performed in ATLAS Silvaco simulator. The overall simulation will be executed by the two-step process such as creation of design structure and then numerical simulation. The placing of the structured doped solar cells on a specific angle of inclination is examined. The performance metrics of the proposed solar cell will be evaluated by analysing the bulk thickness with respect to the angle of inclination. The other aspects which could measure the efficiency of the proposed design is the short circuit current, open-circuit voltage, maximum power, fill factor and efficiency of designed PERC solar cell. The supreme fill factor and efficiency attained is 80.71% and 23.8219%.

articleTitle: Analysing the Effects of Varying Parameters in a MESFET
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: The purpose of the paper is to study, analyze, and understand the different properties of a MESFET. The paper discusses how the variations in different properties and parameters affect the operation of a MESFET. The properties that are considered are the I-V characteristics, the electric field, and the doping properties of a MESFET. In I-V characteristics, change in channel length by 0.3 μm to 0.9 μm, drain current increase by 140%. The gate material used is the Ti-Pt-Au interface because it provides a high barrier that reduces the leakage current. The channel material used is Si due to its good I-V characteristics and cost-effectiveness. And also if using channel material GaAs instead of Ge, saturation occurs at 2.1 V, and for Ge, it is at 2.6 V. n-type MESFET provides five times higher current than p-type MESFET.
